'''Alroy Kever''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who commanded the [[King's Own Guard]], an elite paramilitary unit of the [[Lazerian army]]. They were assigned by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]] to watch over the [[Empeth Crystal]]s during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The harvested crystals from the [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]] were stored in their [[Alroy Kever's residence|residence]].<ref name="LIV" />
